title: docs: Add link to docs source
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

It was hard to navigate to the source file, this adds the link to docs source in the comment.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] :computer: have added unit/e2e tests (if appropriate)
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: sidharthv96

comments.label_reasoning: The comment identifies an incorrect relative path being generated, which is a logic error in path computation that would produce wrong file links.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment identifies a bug with incorrect paths and provides a specific code suggestion to fix it, including adding an import and modifying the function logic.
